people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: At that time, Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”
translations.bsb: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel once again.”
translations.kjv: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.
translations.asv: At that time Jehovah said unto Joshua, Make thee knives of flint, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.
